### 1. Individual Income Tax Rate(s) and Brackets

Montana restructured its personal income tax into a two-bracket system starting in tax year 2024, with rates that change between tax years 2025 and 2026:

#### Tax Year 2025
* **Single and Married Filing Separately**:
  * First $21,100 of taxable ordinary income: **4.7%**
  * Taxable ordinary income exceeding $21,100: **5.9%**
* **Married Filing Jointly and Qualifying Surviving Spouse**:
  * First $42,200 of taxable ordinary income: **4.7%**
  * Taxable ordinary income exceeding $42,200: **5.9%**
* **Head of Household**:
  * First $31,700 of taxable ordinary income: **4.7%**
  * Taxable ordinary income exceeding $31,700: **5.9%**
* *Net Long-Term Capital Gains Rates (2025)*: Taxed separately at preferential rates of **3.0%** and **4.1%**, based on applicable bracket thresholds.
* **Official URL**: https://revenue.mt.gov/taxes/individual-income-tax/tax-tables-and-deductions

#### Tax Year 2026 (Changed under House Bill 337)
House Bill 337 (69th Legislature) broadens the lower tax bracket and cuts the top rate from 5.9% to 5.65%:
* **Single and Married Filing Separately**:
  * $0.00 to $47,500: **4.7%**
  * Over $47,500: **5.65%**
* **Married Filing Jointly and Qualifying Surviving Spouse**:
  * $0.00 to $95,000: **4.7%**
  * Over $95,000: **5.65%**
* **Head of Household**:
  * $0.00 to $71,250: **4.7%**
  * Over $71,250: **5.65%**
* *Net Long-Term Capital Gains Rates (2026)*: Rates remain **3.0%** and **4.1%**, with the bracket thresholds adjusted to align with the new ordinary income tiers.
* **Official URL**: https://revenue.mt.gov/news/2025/11/14/hb337-2026-2027-montana-individual-income-tax-changes

---

### 2. Corporate Income Tax Rate(s) and Minimum Tax

* **Applicability**: Applies to both **Tax Year 2025** and **Tax Year 2026** (no statutory changes).
* **Standard Rate**: **6.75%** of Montana taxable income.
* **Water’s Edge Election Rate**: **7%**.
* **Alternative Gross Sales Tax Rate**: **0.5%** (available to corporations whose sole activity in Montana consists of sales, that do not own or rent real estate or tangible personal property in Montana, and whose Montana annual gross sales do not exceed $100,000; § 15-31-122, MCA).
* **Minimum Tax**: **$50**.
* **Official URL**: https://revenue.mt.gov/taxes/business-taxes/corporate-income-tax

---

### 3. State Sales and Use Tax Rate & Local Rates

* **Applicability**: Applies to both **Tax Year 2025** and **Tax Year 2026**.
* **State General Sales and Use Tax Rate**: Montana has **no general statewide sales and use tax (0%)**.
* **Local Option Sales Taxes**: Local jurisdictions generally cannot impose local sales taxes. However, qualifying designated resort areas and communities are authorized to levy a **Local Resort Tax** of up to **3%** on accommodations, food establishments, alcohol establishments, and luxury goods/services (§ 7-6-1503, MCA). In addition, counties may impose a local-option marijuana excise tax of up to **3%**.
* **Official URLs**:
  * https://revenue.mt.gov/taxes/sales-tax-guidance-for-montana-business-and-residents
  * https://revenue.mt.gov/taxes/business-taxes/miscellaneous-taxes-and-fees/local-resort-tax

---

### 4. Gross Receipts, Franchise, Margin, or Other Notable Business Taxes

* **Applicability**: Applies to both **Tax Year 2025** and **Tax Year 2026**.
* **General Margin / Franchise Tax**: Not found (Montana does not levy an entity-level margin tax or separate general corporate franchise tax).
* **Public Contractor’s Gross Receipts Tax (CGR)**: 
  * A **1%** license tax withheld on gross receipts from public construction contracts awarded by the state, counties, cities, or public schools where the total contract value exceeds **$80,000** (§ 15-50-205, MCA). 
  * Contractors can claim this 1% payment as a dollar-for-dollar credit against Montana corporate or individual income tax liability or obtain a refund against business personal property taxes and motor vehicle registration fees.
  * **Official URL**: https://revenue.mt.gov/taxes/business-taxes/miscellaneous-taxes-and-fees/contractors-gross-receipts-tax
* **Lodging Facility Sales and Use Tax**: 
  * Montana levies a combined **8%** tax on accommodations: a **4%** Lodging Facility Use Tax plus a **4%** Lodging Facility Sales Tax.
  * **Official URL**: https://revenue.mt.gov/taxes/business-taxes/miscellaneous-taxes-and-fees/lodging-facility-sales-and-use-tax
* **Rental Vehicle Sales and Use Tax**:
  * Imposes a **4%** tax on sales/charges for vehicle rentals.
  * **Official URL**: https://revenue.mt.gov/forms-repository (Form RVT)
